answer: Agents bond stake to an epoch and prove in zero knowledge a valid evaluation of its identity polynomial; Semaphore membership binds the proof to one registered identity. RLN derives a nullifier per epoch, so messages labeled orchard, glacier, or sonnet remain private, but duplicate use yields two Shamir-related shares that recover the agent’s RLN secret—not its wallet key—and triggers verifiable, immediate slashing of bonded collateral.
